name: hematite
enchant_note: Iron ore that has already rusted: it holds very little magic.
protection_note: Bloodstone: the old surgeons pressed it to a wound to stop the bleeding. It is iron that has already rusted, so it neither rusts nor carries a spark.
lore_descriptor: streaked deep red, the iron ore the ancients called bloodstone
first_pickup_chronicle: Hematite armor, bloodstone. Cold things and the dead shy off. Heavy.
design_notes: Fills pf 16 gap. Modest damage but anti-undead and cold-resistant. Magical-friendly (max_enchant 3) — the legends called it a soul-anchor metal.
